title: TOR330 – TOR DES GÉANTS race page (2026 edition facts, 2027 rollover)
claims: The TOR330 race page lists 330 km, about 24,000 m of elevation gain, a maximum time of 150 hours, and start and finish in Courmayeur, Valle d'Aosta, Italy.

The page has rolled over to the 2027 edition: 12–18 September 2027, with two start groups at 10:00 and 12:00 on 12 September and a finish cut-off at 18:00 on 18 September 2027; the 2026 dates (13–19 September 2026) are no longer shown.

The page states that the organisation imposes no compulsory stages and that the winner is the runner who completes the race in the shortest time, deciding when and how long to stop for rest and refreshment.
The route runs at the foot of the highest Four-Thousanders of the Alps and through the Gran Paradiso Natural Park and the Mont Avic Regional Park.
The page lists 1,100 bibs and an awards ceremony at 11:00 at Parco Bollino, now dated 19 September 2027; the 2026 date (20 September 2026) is no longer shown.
The page links seven split GPX files, one full-track GPX, an elevation profile PDF and a timetable PDF/XLSX.
The page's General Information section states: 'The TOR330 - Tor des Géants® is the first and only race to combine long distance with the individual style of runners'.
The same section states: 'The Tor des Géants® is the first race of this kind to cover an entire region'.
